name: etherpk
description: EtherPK for Claude Code: notes in plain Markdown that you and Claude both read and write.

plugins.name: etherpk
plugins.description: Your EtherPK notes in Claude Code. Claude searches, reads and edits a synced graph, kept end-to-end encrypted across your devices, or a graph folder on this device, and writes pages, journal entries and tasks in the EtherPK Format.

graph.title: Synced graph
graph.description: The name or id of a synced graph, as the graph's Settings → Agents tab in EtherPK shows it. Leave it empty to use a graph folder instead.

graph_folder.title: Graph folder
graph_folder.description: A graph folder on this device, which holds pages/ and journals/. Leave it empty to use a synced graph instead.

sync_server.title: Sync Server
sync_server.description: Only for a synced graph on a Sync Server of your own, when this device is logged in to more than one. Leave it empty otherwise.
